block.field: Damage accumulates as filled boxes — narrative state, not HP.
When you do something risky under pressure, roll +Cool.
When you threaten violence to make them do what you want, roll +Hard.
When you use leverage on an NPC, roll +Hot.
When you size up a tense scene, roll +Sharp.
When you open your mind to the strangeness, roll +Weird.
When you help or interfere with someone, roll +Hx.
Gear is tracked by narrative tags — harm/handy/scary etc.
When Hx hits +4 reset to -1 and tick advancement.
Where did you come from, and why are you here? A short narrative paragraph.
One secret only one other character knows.
